wars.outcome: In 1804 Bishan Singh assisted Colonel Monson; in revenge the Maratha Empire and the Pindaris repeatedly raided the state, and tribute was demanded until 1817.
wars.note: No territory changed hands on the page; Bishan Singh made a subsidiary alliance with the East India Company on 10 February 1818.

sources.title: Bundi State
sources.note: Rao Deva took over Bundi in 1241 (Haravati or Haroti); Akbar conferred Rao Raja on Surjan Singh in 1569; Maratha and Pindari raids 1804-1817; subsidiary alliance 10 February 1818; area 5,750 km2; accession signed 7 April 1949.

sources.title: Kota State
sources.note: In 1631 Rao Raja Ratan Singh of Bundi partitioned the province of Kota from his primary domain and granted it to Rao Madho Singh.

notes: Two pages opened (Bundi State, Kota State). Conflicts: founding 1241 (page) against 1342 (the figure often given; the page does not mention it); Budh Singh 1696-1707 and 1707-1730; Umaid Singh 1749-1770 and 1773-1804. The page gives no territorial gain or loss and nothing on the Mughal or Maratha periods beyond the title of 1569 and the raids of 1804-1817. british-empire (sa-06) should record the vassal_start for bundi-state from the subsidiary alliance of 10 February 1818 to 1947, and the mughal-empire dossier the vassalage after 1569 if a page dates it. kota-state and jhalawar-state have dossiers in this batch.
